official__k1_status_final.instruction: Inspect the small square immediately to the left of the 'Final K-1' label at the top of page 1. Return exactly CHECKED when that square contains any printed X, check mark, fill, or crossing stroke. Return exactly UNCHECKED only when that square is visually empty. The source document may use a typed X rather than a check-mark glyph. Do not decide from the label text alone or from the nearby Amended K-1 square; evaluate this square independently.

official__k1_status_amended.instruction: Inspect the small square immediately to the left of the 'Amended K-1' label at the top of page 1. Return exactly CHECKED when that square contains any printed X, check mark, fill, or crossing stroke. Return exactly UNCHECKED only when that square is visually empty. The source document may use a typed X rather than a check-mark glyph. Do not decide from the label text alone or from the nearby Final K-1 square; evaluate this square independently.
